status: frozen before segmentation extraction and mass evaluation
scope: LeFood development comparison only; all 524 pairs and five existing episodes; no records excluded or relabeled

model.training_data: FoodSeg103 per author's model card; no new dataset download or redistribution
model.preprocessing: EXIF orientation, RGB, resize full image to 512x512 bilinear, ImageNet normalization. Full-frame resize is an explicit transfer choice; author validation used center crop.
model.binary_rule: argmax over 104 classes is nonzero; background=0; no tuned probability or area threshold
model.role: frozen predicted features; not ground-truth masks

pair_features: concatenate before, after, after-minus-before and after-area / max(before-area, one 512x512 pixel), with ratio clipped to [0,2]
feature_scaling: mean and standard deviation fitted on the current training partition only; constant-feature scale=1; divide by sqrt(number of features)

segmentation_and_combined_search.training_weights: equal total weight per original food group
segmentation_and_combined_search.selection: minimum group-balanced MAE over original inner folds; ordered first minimum

split_checks: original image file identity before and after
uncertainty: paired bootstrap of dependency blocks, 2000 resamples, seed 20261003, retaining original group-balanced MAE within each sampled block collection
gate_caveat: Zero-label gates are provisional until source conflicts are resolved. No claim of human-verified empty-plate performance or validated mask IoU.
pseudo_label_policy: AI review labels are proposals with provenance and human_review=pending. Never overwrite mass labels; never use AI-produced labels as a gold test set; never train on held-out-image pseudo-labels for these folds. LLM mass guesses are excluded.
deployment: Retain current demo model until adoption criteria and independent mask/source review support a change. No category pivot.
